activity.notes: Kabbah's first elected presidency ended when the Armed Forces Revolutionary Council coup removed his government on 25 May 1997. ATLAS preserves the interruption rather than drawing a false continuous 1996-2007 term.

sources.title: Ahmad Tejan Kabbah
sources.citation_text: The Commonwealth Oral History Project identifies Ahmad Tejan Kabbah as President of Sierra Leone in 1996-97 and 1998-2007.

sources.title: UNOMSIL Background
sources.citation_text: United Nations peacekeeping history records that Kabbah was returned to office on 10 March 1998 after the military junta was expelled.
